proposalConstraints: Clarify openspec-thin-integration using host-observable process outcome precedence only.
Preserve current diagnostic taxonomy and valid-JSON non-zero formal-outcome behavior.
Do not broaden production classification with Windows/exit-code/empty-stdout/stderr heuristics.
Replace the non-portable self-SIGKILL universal assertion with deterministic portable boundary coverage.
Preserve explicit host-observable abnormal-close process-failure coverage.
Do not add dependencies, process-supervisor machinery, architecture surface, or merge into Applicable Checks.
